x87_window.author: sistemas3cecasem <paukarvv@gmail.com>
x87_window.note: Adapted sliding x87 window in the private H5 runtime. Retains array sizeof, all eight logical values and exact shadows, zero-on-pop, existing fallback shift helpers, and per-thread/callback snapshots. The original patch is retained for attribution; it is not applied to the pinned vendor tree.

mojoshader.note: Last revision with assembler/preprocessor (removed in 7c3fbde). Marked local extensions implement PS1.1/1.4 TEXCRD/TEXLD, PS1.4 implicit sampler metadata, scalar legacy VS fog, and explicit-DCL input semantics for SM1 BGRA swizzles. The vendored snapshot includes the marked local changes; upstream checkout alone is insufficient.

bcdec.reason: The copied D3D9 texture decoder is self-contained; no bcdec or etcpak source is built.
